name: sat-core
title: Consistency check with minimal unsatisfiable cores

reference.cite: Liffiton & Sakallah 2008, Algorithms for computing minimal unsatisfiable subsets of constraints
Jabs 2025, RustSAT: a library for SAT solving in Rust

assumptions.text: Each claim is true or false under classical semantics.
Only hard relations count: assumed claims, hard constraints, and unweighted claim-to-claim support (implication) and contradict (exclusion) links. Weighted evidence is ignored.
A set of claims each at P >= 0.95 can be satisfiable here and still jointly improbable; that is wmc-exact's job.

cost.typical: milliseconds for thousands of clauses; one SAT call per core member to shrink

assume.description: Which claims are asserted true: every claim except undercut defeaters, or only noticed ones.

max_cores.description: Enumerate up to this many minimal cores (MARCO).
